triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable rights (“Rights”) to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021

subject_names.span: 5,812,247 Shares Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund Issuable Upon the Exercise of Subscription Rights to Acquire Common Shares

subject_tickers.span: The Rights will be, subject to notice of issuance, admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “ACP.RT” during the course of the Offer.

security_class.span: entitling the holders of these Rights to subscribe (the “Offer”) for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares of beneficial interest

rights_per_share.span: will receive one Right for each outstanding Common Share owned on the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle the holders to purchase one new Common Share for every three Rights held (1 for 3).

price_reference.span: a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date, as such date may be extended from time to time, and each of the four (4) immediately preceding trading days

price_pct.span: a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 87% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Common Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date, the Subscription Price will be 87% of the Fund’s NAV per Common Share

record_date.span: to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on June 16, 2021, unless extended as described in this Prospectus Supplement

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise the Rights issued to them pursuant to the Offer

max_new_shares.span: The Fund is issuing to Record Date Shareholders transferable Rights to subscribe for an aggregate of 5,812,247 Common Shares.

notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement for a transferable rights offering by Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund. Subscription price is 92.5% of the five-day average NYSE market price (ending on the expiration date), with a floor of 87% of NAV; recorded as reference market plus a floor (the effective price is the greater of the two). Estimated subscription price $11.11 is an estimate only. Expiration is June 16, 2021 unless extended; no extension stated. Over-subscription privilege exists for record date shareholders who fully exercise (the excerpt's own over-subscription heading is in the same document, p. S-3 and S-12); the span quoted is the summary passage, the over-subscription privilege heading text is 'Over-Subscription Privilege'. Part 05 is a short fragment.
